violation_type.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
violation_type.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

finding_variants.text: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.
The primary caregiver needs to replace the batteries in the smoke detectors.
There was no smoke detector in the home.
There was no smoke detector in the room designated for the children's use.
There was not a smoke detector in one room that the children use for nap time.  *This was corrected at inspection when the smoke detector was hung back up.
The 2 smoke alarms did not work in 2 areas using by children.
